LaunchOS v0.4: adds a **System monitor** and mouse hover highlights, and fixes several bugs.

- **Mouse hover**: icons, tiles, menu rows and Setup options grow and light up when the mouse is over them. A resting mouse never steals focus from the keyboard or controller.
- **System monitor** (new tile, top bar icon, and in the side menu): live CPU, memory, network and storage, one-minute charts with hover readouts, the busiest processes, and per-core load. A pauses, B goes back.
- Idle CPU use is about 10 times lower (controller checks no longer run every frame when no controller is connected).
- Home remembers which tile you were on when you come back from an app.
- Browser: Guide button (or View + Menu) on a controller returns home; the address bar no longer gets overwritten while you type.
- Clicking anywhere on the volume slider sets the volume to that spot.

Download **LaunchOS.zip**, unzip it, then in VirtualBox choose **Machine > Add** and pick **LaunchOS.vbox**. Check the version in Settings > About LaunchOS.
